scripts.lighthouse: NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning BASCIK_SITE_URL=https://bascik.dev bascik --build && lhci autorun --config=./lighthouse/lighthouserc.json && lhci autorun --config=./lighthouse/lighthouserc.desktop.json && lhci autorun --config=./lighthouse/lighthouserc.light.json
scripts.lighthouse:all: NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning BASCIK_SITE_URL=https://bascik.dev bascik --build && node lighthouse/generate-config.ts && lhci autorun --config=./lighthouse/lighthouserc.all.json && lhci autorun --config=./lighthouse/lighthouserc.all-light.json
scripts.lighthouse:ci: NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning BASCIK_SITE_URL=https://bascik.dev bascik --build && lhci autorun --config=./lighthouse/lighthouserc.json && lhci autorun --config=./lighthouse/lighthouserc.desktop.json && lhci autorun --config=./lighthouse/lighthouserc.light.json
scripts.unit: yarn workspace @bascik/bascik build && vitest run --project unit
scripts.integration: yarn workspace @bascik/bascik build && yarn workspace @bascik/language-server build && vitest run --project integration
scripts.test: yarn workspace @bascik/bascik build && yarn workspace @bascik/language-server build && vitest run
scripts.coverage: yarn workspace @bascik/bascik build && yarn workspace @bascik/language-server build && vitest run --coverage.enabled && node scripts/update-coverage.ts
scripts.update-coverage: yarn workspace @bascik/bascik build && yarn workspace @bascik/language-server build && vitest run --coverage.enabled && node scripts/update-coverage.ts
